text: emily-design: Quick sync: retention presets modal + region dropdown + encryption indicator. Need copy that doesn't imply key custody, clear CSV headers, and keyboard/a11y checks. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (attached images). ben-pm: Main decision: show org default region at top of list with a tiny tag "Org default" OR show user's last-selected region? I prefer showing org default first, with an inline explanation. tom-eng: Agreed org default first. Implementation note: store user override in profile and show "(saved)" next to region if they've set one. Avoid auto-switching on locale changes. rafa-copy: Copy suggestions (short options): - A: "Retention: 90 days — stored in selected region" - B: "Retention period: 90 days (storage region: us-west-2)" - C: "Data retained for 90 days. Storage region: us-west-2." I like B for clarity and scan-ability. elli-a11y: A11y nits: region dropdown label should include the selected region in accessible name, e.g., label="Storage region, selected: us-west-2". The encryption indicator is currently decorative only; we need it reachable via keyboard and announced. Use aria-live? Maybe role=button with aria-expanded if it reveals more. emily-design: For visual affordance we added a small chevron and a badge that says "Org default" when applicable. Also thinking a faint line under the fallback text: "Using Global fallback (no org region set)" in tiny muted text. nina-legal: Wording check: don't say keys are "stored" by Redwood. For encryption column/cell text prefer: "Customer-managed (KMS region: us-west-2)" or "Platform-managed (Redwood)". No reference to custody. tom-eng: CSV export change: currently headers are region_id and policy_id. We should map them to "Storage region" and "Retention policy name". Example code: ``` // CSV headers mapping const headers = { region_id: 'Storage region', policy_id: 'Retention policy' }; ``` rafa-copy: For the encryption badge visible label: keep it terse on the UI: "Customer-managed" / "Platform-managed". Tooltip (longer): "Customer-managed encryption key — managed in your KMS, region: us-west-2." Nina: is that OK? nina-legal: change "managed in your KMS" to "managed by your KMS" or "under your KMS policy". Prefer: "Customer-managed encryption key (managed by your KMS, region: us-west-2)." elli-a11y: Accessibility implementation suggestion: make the badge a focusable element with aria-labelledby pointing to a visible label and aria-describedby pointing to a visually-hidden expanded description. Avoid role=img. Example: ``` Customer-managed Encryption type Customer-managed encryption key, managed by your KMS, region: us-west-2 ``` This ensures screen readers get both short and long forms. Also ensure the badge keyboard target has a visible focus ring. ben-pm: UX question: show encryption detail in audit CSV? I think yes, column name "Encryption" with values "Platform-managed" / "Customer-managed (KMS region: us-west-2)". That helps ops. tom-eng: Backend note: region strings should use human-readable region names in CSV (e.g., "us-west-2") not internal slugs. Also ensure retention policy name is exported, not ID. emily-design: Visual tweak: swap the retention dropdown and region picker order? Some users expect region first. Thoughts? rafa-copy: For clarity put region first then retention. Copy in the modal should read: "Storage region — Default: Organization setting (change)" when org default applies. If fallback to Global, show: "Storage region — Fallback: Global" (muted). elli-a11y: Keyboard order should be: region picker, retention dropdown, encryption badge, help link. Confirm with devs. Also check contrast on the muted fallback text (needs 4.5:1 against background). nina-legal: One more legal note: in any tooltip/example do NOT include exact key ARNs or internal identifiers. Keep examples generic. ci-bot: Build deployed to staging 2026-03-22T21:05:12 — https://staging.redwood.ai/console/retention — accessibility snapshot attached. tom-eng: I'll push an a11y test job to ensure focus order and SR output for the badge. Tagging @elli-a11y for QA. emily-design: Great. I'll update the figma with copy B, add exposed sr-only nodes in the prototype, and label the CSV change in the spec. Will ping when ready for review. :wave:
